anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow, flattened convex arc with a very large radius relative to the cranial volume, characteristic of a low-polygon mesh.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical protrusion with a base width approximately equal to the visible length from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 160 degrees at the transition between the anterior melon slope and the dorsal rostrum surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Digital low-poly artifacting throughout the mesh geometry; uniform cyan/aquamarine surface with high-intensity white specular highlights along the dorsal ridge.
